findings.ours: src/TGCountryPickerViewController.m:172,310-338 — the list is a hardcoded 22-country fallback, replaced later by an async TDLib getCountries request. Offline or before the response lands the user sees 22 rows and ~12 index letters.
findings.theirs: The full 234-entry country list ships in the bundle as a plain text resource and is parsed synchronously on first access; no network involved, the list is always complete and immediate.
findings.fix: Copy PhoneCountries.txt into the bundle resources and parse it with the original's `code;id;Name` loop as the primary data source (dispatch_once, cached). Keep getCountries only as an optional refresh, never as the source that makes the difference between 22 and 234 rows.

findings.ours: src/TGCountryPickerViewController.m:409-433 — search filters the same table in place: sections collapse to one, the section index disappears instantly, the navigation bar stays visible, and a UISearchBar system Cancel button is toggled (419-425).
findings.theirs: Search runs through TGSearchDisplayMixin: a second UITableView is created and overlaid, the main table gets scrollEnabled = false, the section index view is faded out over 0.15s, and the navigation bar is hidden for the duration of the search.
findings.fix: On search activation: animate the index view alpha to 0 over 0.15s, set tableView.scrollEnabled = NO, and hide the navigation bar animated; reverse on deactivation. Show results in an overlay table rather than mutating the main table's section structure.

findings.ours: src/TGCountryPickerViewController.m:125-131,133-135 — no left bar button item at all; the screen relies on the default navigation back button.
findings.theirs: A TGToolbarButton titled Common.Cancel is installed as leftBarButtonItem, built from the stretchable HeaderButton_Login art (leftCapWidth 11) with white text, shadow UIColorRGBA(0x07080a, 0.35f) and minWidth 59.
findings.fix: Add a left bar button using images/HeaderButton_Login@2x.png and HeaderButton_Login_Pressed@2x.png (both already present in images/, currently unused here), stretchableImageWithLeftCapWidth:11 topCapHeight:0, title "Cancel", white text, shadow colour 0x07080a at 0.35 alpha, minimum width 59.

findings.ours: src/TGCountryPickerViewController.m:163-170,300-308 — an invented "No results" empty state: bold system 15, colour 0x8e8e93, centred vertically over the whole view.
findings.theirs: No empty state exists anywhere on this screen. When the query matches nothing the search results table is simply empty; when the query is cleared the results table is hidden outright.
findings.citation: Telegraph/Telegraph/TGLoginCountriesController.m:473-507 (searchMixin:hasChangedSearchQuery: ends with setSearchResultsTableViewHidden:searchQuery.length == 0 — no empty-state view is ever built)
findings.fix: Delete _emptyLabel, updateEmptyState and its viewDidLayoutSubviews positioning; leave the results table blank on no match.

findings.ours: src/TGCountryPickerViewController.m:374-407 with TGCountrySearchTokens (79-110) — matches against diacritic-folded tokens of the name, plus the initials abbreviation, plus the ISO code, plus the dial code, and requires every query token to prefix-match some token.
findings.theirs: Match is prefix-only against the lowercased country name, or against any space-separated word of it; the query is additionally transliterated to Latin and stripped of combining marks. Neither ISO code nor dial code nor initials are searchable, so typing "380" or "ua" finds nothing.
findings.fix: Reduce matching to: lowercase query, plus a CFStringTransform kCFStringTransformToLatin + StripCombiningMarks variant; accept a row if the lowercased name, or any of its space-separated words, hasPrefix either form. Drop the ISO, dial-code and initials tokens.

findings.ours: src/TGCountryPickerViewController.m — no orientation overrides, so the picker rotates with the device.
findings.theirs: The controller is locked to portrait: shouldAutorotateToInterfaceOrientation returns portrait only, shouldAutorotate returns false, supportedInterfaceOrientations is portrait mask.
findings.fix: Add the same three overrides returning portrait-only / false / UIInterfaceOrientationMaskPortrait.

findings.ours: src/TGCountryPickerViewController.m:213-216,335-337,340-356 — sorting uses localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare and sections are cut from the already-sorted flat array by first letter.
findings.theirs: Sections are keyed by the first character of the name and sorted with compare:options:NSDiacriticInsensitiveSearch | NSWidthInsensitiveSearch | NSForcedOrderingSearch; items inside a section are sorted with the same option mask.
findings.fix: Replace both comparators with [name1 compare:name2 options:NSDiacriticInsensitiveSearch | NSWidthInsensitiveSearch | NSForcedOrderingSearch] so accented names (Åland, Côte d'Ivoire, Curaçao) land in the same section and order the original produced.

findings.ours: src/TGCountryPickerViewController.m:248-295 (styleSearchInputField:) — the placeholder colour is left at the UIKit default grey, and the field's font is forced to systemFontOfSize:14.
findings.theirs: The placeholder colour is explicitly set to UIColorRGB(0x8d9298) via TGHacks; the field's font is never overridden.
findings.fix: Set the placeholder colour to 0x8d9298 (via the same private-ivar hack already used elsewhere in the project) and remove the field.font = systemFontOfSize:14 assignment so the search field keeps UIKit's default metrics.

findings.ours: src/TGCountryPickerViewController.m:258-264 — the SearchInputField background is inserted at index 0 and positioned at y = 0.5 unconditionally.
findings.theirs: The background image view is added on top (addSubview:) and offset by 0.5 only on retina; on non-retina it sits at y = 0. The clear-button glyph is also nudged by setTextFieldClearOffset:0.5 on retina.
findings.fix: Guard the 0.5 offset behind a retina check and apply the matching 0.5 clear-button offset on retina, mirroring TGIsRetina() in the original.

findings.theirs: The login countries screen creates its TGSearchBar without ever assigning a placeholder, so the field starts empty apart from the magnifier icon.
findings.fix: Drop the placeholder assignment on this screen, or verify against the 2013 screenshots before keeping it — the original's search field on this controller carried no placeholder text.
